_note: Human-written pass criteria for each prompt, fixed before any step-2 result was seen and independent of the LLM-compiled specs (different thresholds on purpose). A run passes only if the robot did not flip AND every check holds. 'body' and 'behaviour' are scored separately. Revised 2026-10-18 after the first run, before any further run: 'fallen' = torso tilt > 0.6 rad (was: > 60 deg, which let a robot topple forward 0.8 m and pass); translation rules also require >= 30% of the displacement in the second half of the episode. Added 2026-10-18 before running: L_turn_it, L_hop_fr (LoRA-compiled demo prompts).

behaviour_rules.forward: dx > 0.5 and abs(dy) < 0.5 * dx and dx_2nd_half > 0.3 * dx
behaviour_rules.backward: dx < -0.5 and abs(dy) < 0.5 * abs(dx) and dx_2nd_half < 0.3 * dx
behaviour_rules.left: dy > 0.5 and abs(dx) < 0.5 * dy and dy_2nd_half > 0.3 * dy
behaviour_rules.right: dy < -0.5 and abs(dx) < 0.5 * abs(dy) and dy_2nd_half < 0.3 * dy
